content: The speaker is explaining how the running time of a program, particularly a sorting algorithm, scales with the input size. They emphasize that larger input sizes lead to longer runtimes. To analyze this, they introduce the concept of expressing time as a function of the input size. They also highlight that, in general, it is more useful to consider the upper bound of the running time because it offers a guarantee to the user. This guarantee is valuable, especially in real-time applications where knowing a program's maximum runtime is crucial.
